description: Load the canonical DevSpec implementation contract pointer, enforce a session/repository-scoped successful claim before mutation, and mirror remote-control turns. Claim evidence is observed only from successful DevSpec tool results and is cleared by successful terminal work-item verbs.

hooks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/claim-guard.mjs" session-start; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"DevSpec implementation contract: devspec://product/implementation-contract"}}'; fi

if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/claim-guard.mjs" pre || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"DevSpec denied mutation because the claim guard failed."}}'; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"DevSpec claim guard unavailable: Node.js is required before mutation."}}'; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/claim-guard.mjs" post; else printf '%s\n' 'DevSpec claim observation failed: Node.js is required.' >&2; exit 1; fi
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/remote-control-state.mjs" disable-local --agent "Claude Code" || true
